analyzed: na ca evam api a c ādeḥ dvitīyasya iti dhi śabda sthāne dhi dhi śabda ādeśe sati vas nasoḥ iva prakṛti pratyaya vibhāga sammohaḥ iti vācyam dvis prayogaḥ dvirvacanam ṣāṣṭham iti ṣāṣṭha bhāṣye siddhāntita tvāt anyathā iha eva ṇi lopaḥ na syāt jighāṃsati ityādau sanaḥ sakāreṇa viśiṣṭasya dvitve kṛte hi asvaḥ na bhavati eva iti vācyam

analyzed: tatra eva śabda antara tvāt aprāptau upasaṃkhyānam iti kaiyaṭa nyāsakāra haradatta ādibhiḥ sarvaiḥ eva uktam kim ca ṇi adhikasya api grahaṇe upasargāt sunoti iti atra abhiṣāvayati iti udāhṛtya ṇi antena ābheḥ yogāt sunotim prati anupasarga tvāt katham ṣatvam iti āśaṅkya ābheḥ prakṛti artha viśeṣaka tvena samādhānam bhāṣyakāra ādi uktam asaṅgatam syāt

analyzed: na ca heḥ a caṅi iti liṅgāt prakṛti grahaṇe ṇi adhikasya api grahaṇam iti bhramitavyam jñāpakasya ku tva mātra viṣayaka tvāt tathā ca vārtika mheḥ caṅi pratiṣedha ānarthakyam aṅga anyatvāt jñāpakam tu caṅaḥ nyatra ṇi ante pi ku tva bhāvasya iti tasmāt yukti virodhāt bhāṣya vārtika vṛtti nyāsa ādi granthaiḥ pūrva apara sva granthena ca virodhāt upekṣyaḥ yam kaiyaṭaḥ iti

original: atredaṃ vaktavyam| astu viśiṣṭasya śabdāntaratvaṃ tāvatā'pi prakṛtibhāgasyaidhrūpatvaṃ kenāpagatamityavadhāryatām| na hyupaidhata ityādau tiṅantasyaidhrūpatā nāstīti prakṛtyaṃśe sā hīyate| tathā ca "upasargātsunoti--"iti sūtre vārtikam--"siddhaṃ tvavayavānyatvāt"iti|

original: yattvabhiṣāvayatītyatratyabhāṣyavirodhodbhāvanaṃ, tadviparītam| yataḥ prakṛteḥ sunotirūpānapāyāt kaiyaṭamate siddhā yathoktavyavasthā| tvanmate tu rūpāntaratvena ṇyadhikasyāgrahaṇādasaṅgataiva prāguktavyavasthā syāt| ko hyedhayatisāvayatyorviśeṣaḥ--yadedhateṇryadhikasyāgrahaṇaṃ sunotestu grahaṇamiti|
analyzed: yat tu abhiṣāvayati iti atratya bhāṣya virodha udbhāvanam tad viparītam yatas prakṛteḥ sunoti rūpa anapāyāt kaiyaṭa mate siddhā yathā ukta vyavasthā tvad mate tu rūpa antara tvena ṇi adhikasya agrahaṇāt asaṅga tā eva prāc ukta vyavasthā syāt kaḥ hi edhayati sāvayatyoḥ viśeṣaḥ yat edhate ṇi adhikasya agrahaṇam sunoteḥ tu grahaṇam iti

original: yadapi ṇyantabhādīnāmupasaṃkhyānamupanyastaṃ tadapi nāsmākaṃ pratikūlam, viśiṣṭasya śabdāntaratvena prakṛtyaṃśasya tu ṇicā vyavadhānenopasaṃkhyānasyāvaśyakatvāt| ata eva na tatratyanyāsādibhiḥ svoktyā vā virodhaḥ| pratyuta tavaiva virodhaḥ, ṣāṣṭhe bhāṣyavārtikayoḥ "etyedhatyoḥ--" iti yogaṃ vibhajya "eci" iti viśeṣitatvāt|

original: akṣauhiṇīti| ūhostyasya ūhinī akṣāṇāmūhinīti vigrahaḥ| parimāṇaviśeṣaviśiṣṭā senā akṣauhiṇī| "pūrvapadātsaṃjñāyām" iti ṇatvam| yattu prācā vigṛhītamakṣāṇāmūhaḥ samūhaḥ so'styasyā iti| tadapi uhinīśabdena ṣaṣṭhītatpuruṣa ityevaṃparatayaiva kathañcinneyam| ūhaśabdena samāse tata inau tu vṛdhdirna syāt, antaraṅgeṇa guṇena bādhāt|
analyzed: akṣauhiṇī iti ūhaḥ asti asya ūhinī akṣāṇām ūhinī iti vigrahaḥ parimāṇa viśeṣa viśiṣṭā senā akṣauhiṇī pūrva padāt saṃjñāyām iti ṇatvam yat tu prācā vigṛhītam akṣāṇām ūhaḥ samūhaḥ saḥ asti asyāḥ iti tat api uhinī śabdena ṣaṣṭhī tatpuruṣaḥ iti evaṃparatayā eva kathañcid na iyam ūha śabdena samāse tatas inau tu vṛdhdiḥ na syāt antaraṅgeṇa guṇena bādhāt

original: apavādabhūtāyā api vṛddherūhinīśabdena vigrahe caritārthatvāt| yathoktaṃ prāk-- "iṇ-ṅi-śīnāmād guṇaḥ savarṇadīrghatvāt" iti|

original: śakandhvādiṣviti| śakandhvādiviṣaye tatsiddhyanuguṇaṃ pararūpaṃ vācyamityarthaḥ| ata evāha- tacca ṭeriti| yadi tu "āt" ityadhikārādakārasyaiveṣyeta tarhi manīṣā iti na siddhyeta| kecittu manaḥpatacchabdayoḥ pṛṣodarāditvādantyalope'kārasyaiva pararūpamāhuḥ| śakānāṃ- deśaviśeṣāṇāmandhuḥ - kūpaḥ-śakandhuḥ| karkāṇāṃ rājñāmandhuḥ|
analyzed: śakandhu ādiṣu iti śakandhu ādi viṣaye tad siddhi anuguṇam pararūpam vācyam iti arthaḥ atas eva āha tat ca ṭeḥ iti yadi tu ā t iti adhikārāt akārasya eva iṣyeta tarhi manīṣā iti na siddhyeta kecid tu manaḥ patat śabdayoḥ pṛṣodara ādi tvāt antya lopa ikārasya eva pararūpam āhuḥ śakānām deśa viśeṣāṇām andhuḥ kūpaḥ śakandhuḥ karkāṇām rājñām andhuḥ

original: yattu tvatkapitṛka ityādi| taditthaṃ prācā vyākhyātam-- tvaṃ pitā yasya, ahaṃ pitā yasyeti vigṛhya bahuvrīhisamāse kṛte samāsāvayavayoḥ samāsāntaḥpātinoryuṣmadasmadoḥ sarvārthavācakatvena sarvanāmasaṃjñakatvādajñātādyarthavivakṣāyām "avyayasarvanāmnām" ityakac prasajyeta| tasya smaiprabhṛtīnāmivāṅgādhikāravihitatvābhāvenāṅgasaṃjñānapekṣatvāt|
analyzed: yat tu tvatka pitṛkaḥ ityādi tat ittham prācā vyākhyātam tvam pitā yasya aham pitā yasya iti vigṛhya bahuvrīhi samāse kṛte samāsa avayavayoḥ samāsa antaḥpātinoḥ yuṣmad asmadoḥ sarva artha vācaka tvena sarvanāma saṃjñaka tvāt ajñāta ādi artha vivakṣāyām avyaya sarvanāmnām prasajyeta tasya smai prabhṛtīnām iva aṅga adhikāra vihita tva abhāvena aṅga saṃjñā anapekṣa tvāt

original: tataśca tvakatpitṛka ityādyaniṣṭaṃ prasajyeteti| nyāsakṛtā'pi anvarthasaṃjñābalādeva saṃjñānirāse kṛte'kaj na bhaviṣyatītyāśaṅkya samudāyo hi viśeṣe vartate, pūrvapadantu sarvārthatāyā anapetamevetyuktam| tadetatsarvaṃ prāmādikameva| tathā hi-- jahatsvārthāyāṃ vṛttau samāsāvayavayorartha eva nāsti|
analyzed: tatas ca ityādi aniṣṭam prasajyeta iti nyāsa kṛtā api anvartha saṃjñā balāt eva saṃjñā nirāse na bhaviṣyati iti āśaṅkya samudāyaḥ hi viśeṣe vartate pūrva padam tu sarvārthatāyāḥ an apetam eva iti uktam tat etat sarvam prāmādikam eva tathā hi jahat svārthāyām vṛttau samāsa avayavayoḥ arthaḥ eva na asti

original: ajahatsvārthāyāmapi svārthaviśiṣṭānyapadārthavṛttitvenopasarjanatvaṃ spaṣṭameva| evaṃ ca samāsāntaḥpātinoryuṣmadasmadoḥ sarvārthavācakatvenetyādi granthaḥ, samudāyo hityādinyāsagranthaśca pakṣadvaye'pi vyāhataḥ| kiṃ caivam atisarvāyetyatra smāyadeśo durvāraḥ, aṅgādhikāre tadantagrahaṇāt| tvaduktarītyā sarvaśabdasya sarvārthatānapāyāt|
analyzed: ajahatsvārthāyām api svārtha viśiṣṭa anya padārtha vṛtti tvena upasarjana tvam spaṣṭam eva evam ca samāsa antaḥpātinoḥ yuṣmad asmadoḥ sarva artha vācaka tvena ityādi granthaḥ samudāyaḥ h ityādi nyāsa granthaḥ ca pakṣa dvaye pi vyāhataḥ kim ca evam atisarvāya iti atra durvāraḥ aṅga adhikāre tad anta grahaṇāt tvad ukta rītyā sarva śabdasya sarva arthatā anapāyāt

original: na hi pūrvapade sarvārthatā uttarapade tu neti yuktimat| api caivaṃ gauṇatve sarvādīnāṃ sarvārthavācakatvaṃ nāstīti svoktyā saha virodhaḥ syāditi yatkiṃcidetat|

original: yadapi vyācakhyuḥ-- tvaṃ pitā yasyetyādau vigrahavākye prāptā saṃjñā niṣidhyate iti| tadapi na| vigrahavākyaṃ hi laukikamalaukikaṃ vā vivakṣitam ? nādyaḥ| prakriyāvākye'yaṃ niṣedho na tu laukika iti kaiyaṭagranthavirodhāt, prakṛtasanadarbhagatapūrvāparasvagranthavirodhācca| na dvitīyaḥ|
analyzed: yat api vyācakhyuḥ tvam pitā yasya ityādau vigraha vākye prāptā saṃjñā niṣidhyate iti tat api na vigraha vākyam hi laukikam alaukikam vā vivakṣitam na ādyaḥ prakriyā vākyā iyam niṣedhaḥ na tu laukikaḥ iti kaiyaṭa grantha virodhāt prakṛta sana darbha gata pūrva apara sva grantha virodhāt ca na dvitīyaḥ

original: tasya yuṣmad su pitṛ su ityākārakatvena tvaṃ pitetyākārakatvāyogāt|
analyzed: tasya yuṣmat su pitṛ su iti ākāraka tvena tvam pitā iti ākāraka tva ayogāt

original: yadapi vyācakhyuḥ-- nanvatisarvādau saṃjñā na pravartate tvatkapitṛkādau tu saṃjñā pravartata ityatra kiṃ vinigamakantatrāha--anaṅgakāryatveneti| aṅgaśabdaḥ samudāyaparaḥ| tenātisarva ityatrāṅgasaṃjñā'pekṣitā sarvanāmno'ṅgāt smāyādividhānādavayavayamātrasya satyapi sarvanāmatve doṣābhāvāt|
analyzed: yat api vyācakhyuḥ nanu atisarva ādau saṃjñā na pravartate tvatka pitṛka ādau tu saṃjñā pravartate iti atra kim vinigamakam tatra āha anaṅga kāryatvena iti aṅga śabdaḥ samudāya paraḥ tena atisarvaḥ iti atra aṅga saṃjñā apekṣitā sarvanāmnā ūṅgāt smāya ādi vidhānāt avayava ya mātrasya sati api sarvanāma tve doṣa abhāvāt

original: samudāye ca samudāyārthaṃ prati sarvāderupasarjanatvāt tadantasya saṃjñā na bhavatīti yuktam| iha tu avayavamātrasya sā cikīrṣitā na samudāyasya, avayavaśca svārthamātrapradhāna iti syāt prasaṅga iti vaiṣamyamastītyāśaya iti| tadapi na| aṅgādhikāre tadantavidheḥ sarvasaṃmatatvenāvayavamātre satyapi sarvanāmatve doṣo nāstītyuktevryāhatatvāt|
analyzed: samudāye ca samudāya artham prati sarva ādeḥ upasarjana tvāt tad antasya saṃjñā na bhavati iti yuktam iha tu avayava mātrasya sā cikīrṣitā na samudāyasya avayavaḥ ca svārtha mātra pradhānaḥ iti syāt prasaṅgaḥ iti vaiṣamyam asti iti āśayaḥ iti tat api na aṅga adhikāre tad anta vidheḥ sarva saṃmata tvena avayava mātre sati api sarvanāma tve doṣaḥ na asti iti uktyāḥ vryāhata tvāt

original: aṅgādhikāraparibhāṣayā smai syāditi svagranthavirodhācca| athāyamāśayaḥ--prāk pravṛttā'pi saṃjñā arthāntaropasaṃkrame sati gateti| tarhi akajapi gacchatu| nanu kāryakālapakṣe smāyādyarthaṃ punaḥ saṃjñāpekṣitā, sā ca durlabhetyāśayaḥ iti cet? astvevam| na tvasau prakṛtagranthārthaḥ| nyāsagranthavisaṃvādena 'iti nyāsakṛnmatam' iti vākyaśeṣavirodhāt|
analyzed: aṅga adhikāra paribhāṣayā syāt iti sva grantha virodhāt ca atha ayam āśayaḥ prāk pravṛttā api saṃjñā artha antara upasaṃkrame sati gatā iti tarhi gacchatu nanu kārya kāla pakṣe smāyā ādi artham punar saṃjñā apekṣitā sā ca durlabhā iti āśayaḥ iti ced astu evam na tu asau prakṛta grantha arthaḥ nyāsa grantha visaṃvādena iti nyāsa kṛt matam iti vākyaśeṣa virodhāt

original: nyāsagranthastvanupadamevodāhariṣyate|
analyzed: nyāsa granthaḥ tu anupadam eva udāhariṣyate

original: yadapi vyācakhyuḥ-- aṅgapradhānaṃ bādhyaṃ tadviruddhamanaṅgaṃ bādhakamityarthaḥ| tathā ca kapratyayāpavādatvādakac syadityartha iti| tadapi kliṣṭaṃ vyarthaṃ ca, nyāsagranthāsaṃmataṃ ca| tathā hi, tvatkapitṛko matkapitṛka iti vṛttigranthaṃ vyākhyāya nyāsakāra ujjagrāha-- nanu ca anvarthasaṃjñākaraṇādevātra saṃjñānirāse kṛte'kaj na bhaviṣyati|
analyzed: yat api vyācakhyuḥ aṅga pradhānam bādhyam tad viruddham anaṅgam bādhakam iti arthaḥ tathā ca kapratyaya apavāda tvāt akac syat iti arthaḥ iti tat api kliṣṭam vyartham ca nyāsa grantha a saṃmatam ca tathā hi tvatka pitṛkaḥ matka pitṛkaḥ iti vṛtti grantham vyākhyāya nyāsakāraḥ ujjagrāha nanu ca anvartha saṃjñā karaṇāt eva atra saṃjñā nirāse kṛta ikac na bhaviṣyati

original: na hyatra sarvārthatā sambhavati viśeṣaviṣayatvāt| naitadasti| samudāyo hi viśeṣe vartate pūrvapadaṃ tu sarvārthatāyā anapetameva| bhavatu tarhi anayoranantarayoretatsūtraviṣayatā | priyaviśvāyetyādestu nopapadyate| na hi priyaviśvādayaḥ sarveṣāṃ nāmāni| nāpi tadavayavabhūtānāṃ viśvādiśabdānāṃ kiñcitsarvanāmakāryamupapadyate|
analyzed: na hi atra sarvārthatā sambhavati viśeṣa viṣaya tvāt na etat asti samudāyaḥ hi viśeṣe vartate pūrva padam tu sarvārthatāyāḥ an apetam eva bhavatu tarhi anayoḥ anantarayoḥ etad sūtra viṣaya tā priyaviśvāya ityādeḥ tu nā upapadyate na hi priyaviśva ādayaḥ sarveṣām nāmāni nā api tad avayava bhūtānām viśva ādi śabdānām kiñcid sarvanāmakāryam upapadyate

original: smaiprabhṛtīnāmaṅgakāryatvāt| viśvādiśabdānāmanaṅgatvāt| evaṃ manyate--tvatkapitṛko matkapitṛka ityatrākaj mā bhūd ityetadarthaṃ tāvadetadārabdhavyam| priyaviśvāyetyādāvapi vispaṣṭārthaṃ bhaviṣyatīti| anena hi nyāsagranthenāṅgasaṃjñā'napekṣatvamevārtho labhyate, sa ca svotprekṣitavyākhyāyāṃ dūrotsārita eva|
analyzed: smai prabhṛtīnām aṅga kārya tvāt viśva ādi śabdānām anaṅga tvāt evam manyate tvatka pitṛkaḥ matka pitṛkaḥ iti atra akat mā bhūt iti etad artham tāvat etat ārabdhavyam priya viśvāya ityādau api vispaṣṭa artham bhaviṣyati iti anena hi nyāsa granthena aṅga saṃjñā an apekṣa tvam eva arthaḥ labhyate sa ca sva utprekṣita vyākhyāyām dūra utsāritaḥ eva

original: yadapi vyācakhyuḥ--yadyapi sūtravārtikakṛtorapyetanmataṃ tathā'pi nyāsakṛtā vivṛtatvād nyāsakṛnmatamityuktamiti| tadapi sthavīyaḥ, vārtikakṛtā asyārthasyāspṛṣṭatvāt| nyāsakṛtā samāse kṛte satītyadi vadatā tvaduktārthasya dūratyaktatvena tadvivṛtatvābhāvācca|

original: yadapyāhuḥ- nyāsakṛcchabdena sūtrakāra eva vivakṣita ityādi| tadapi na | sūtrakāramate bahuvrīhāvityādipūrvagranthena saha virodhāt| bhāṣyakāramate tviti granthena tasya vicchinnatvācca| tasmādiha prācaḥ prakriyāgranthāstadvyākhyātṛgranthāścāpātaramaṇīyā evetyāstāṃ tāvat|
analyzed: yat api āhuḥ nyāsa kṛt śabdena sūtrakāraḥ eva vivakṣitaḥ ityādi tat api na sūtrakāra mate bahuvrīhau ityādi pūrva granthena saha virodhāt bhāṣyakāra mate tu iti granthena tasya vicchinna tvāt ca tasmāt iha prācaḥ prakriyā granthāḥ tad vyākhyātṛ granthāḥ ca āpāta ramaṇīyāḥ eva iti āstām tāvat

original: yadi tu prakriyāgrantho'pi kathaṃcidbhāṣyāvirodhena vyākhyeya ityāgrahastarhītthaṃ vyākhyāyatām-- nanu priyaviśvāyeti gauṇatayā gatārtham| ato niṣkarṣamāha-- sūtrakāramata iti| bahuvrīhāviti| cikīrṣite satīti śeṣaḥ| gauṇatvamātra iti| mātraśabdo'vadhāraṇe, gauṇatve eva na tu tataḥ prāk| tathā ca sūtraṃ pratyākhyātamiti bhāvaḥ|
analyzed: yadi tu prakriyā granthaḥ api kathaṃcid bhāṣya avirodhena vyākhyeyaḥ iti āgrahaḥ tarhi ittham vyākhyāyatām nanu priya viśvāya iti gauṇatayā gatārtham atas niṣkarṣam āha sūtrakāra mate iti bahuvrīhau iti cikīrṣite sati iti śeṣaḥ gauṇa tva mātre iti mātra śabdaḥ avadhāraṇe gauṇa tve eva na tu tatas prāk tathā ca sūtram pratyākhyātam iti bhāvaḥ

original: yattu vyācakhyuḥ-- ādiḥ- ūṅapekṣayā pūrvaḥ, prātipadikaṃ, tadvadbhāvāt tadavayavatvena grahāt pūrvantavadbhāvāditi yāvaditi; tadapi kliṣṭaṃ svaparagranthaviruddhaṃ ca| uktarītyā hi kāṇḍe kuḍye ityādāvapi "ekavacanamutsargataḥ' iti suḥ pravarteta| tadvāraṇāya cā'pratyaya iti prasajyapratiṣedhābhyupagame prakṛte doṣaḥ|

original: śvaśrūrityatraikādeśā'bhāvena liṅgaviśiṣṭaparibhāṣāyā āvaśyakatvācca| yattu- tatra "śvaśuraḥ śvaśrvā" iti nirdeśātsvādaya iti; tanna, nirdeśasya śabdaparatvāt| "viparābhyāṃ jeḥ" "ṅeryaḥ" itivat|

original: śvaśurasyeti| puṃyogalakṣaṇe ṅīṣi prāpte ūṅ| tatsanniyogena ca vidhīyamāno lopaḥ sannihitatvādantyasyaivā'kārasya, na tvādeḥ| etacca vacanaṃ "śvaśuraḥ śvaśrvā"iti nirdeśasiddhārthakathanaparam| ato'pi prathamā'kārasya lopo na śaṅkyaḥ|
